title: Palcheck separation oracle omits the state_congested vs route_tie pair under CVD modes
detail: The exact gestalt pair this PR de-conflicts (tie vs congested) is not in the runtime CVD oracle. Re-adding a route_tie remap colliding with congested's pale-amber remap passes palcheck.
recommended_fix: Add append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.state_congested, p.route_tie}) to the signal pairs in a11y_separation_check so every mode's simulation enforces it.

title: Warm-family classifier is weaker than a numeric hue-separation pin for route_tie vs state_congested
evidence:
testing.expect(t, p.state_congested.r > p.state_congested.g && p.state_congested.g > p.state_congested.b,
		"sanity: state_congested must stay in the warm family")
testing.expect(t, !(p.route_tie.r > p.route_tie.g && p.route_tie.g > p.route_tie.b),
		"route_tie must NOT share the warm warning family")
detail: Brief AC3 asks to pin the hue separation between route_tie and state_congested. Only a boolean channel-ordering classifier pins it; a magenta congested (~280 deg) stays within ~16 deg of the violet tie while passing.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit hue_degrees(p.route_tie) vs hue_degrees(p.state_congested) delta >= 90 expectation, mirroring the existing pipe-tier loop.

title: draw_tie_mark draw path (annulus geometry, winding, caption) has no render-level test
detail: Shape coverage pins only the pure predicate and constants; the actual triangle annulus (winding, radii, seam) is never rendered in any test. Acceptable under the goldens-exclude-assists doctrine, but unverified.
recommended_fix: Optionally add a harness assist-draw golden or unit check on r_in/r_out bounds under extreme v.scale to cover degenerate thin-ring cases.

title: derive_a11y_palettes.py anchor removal and modes-table route_tie absence are untested
evidence:
remap["route_glow"] = (teal[0], teal[1], teal[2], PAL["route_glow"][3])
-    remap["route_tie"]  = (pale[0], pale[1], pale[2], PAL["route_tie"][3])
detail: No test pins that the shipped modes tables omit route_tie or that the derive script no longer emits it (script also cannot parse the commented palette.json). Reintroduction is only caught downstream.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck presence assertion that palette_apply_mode leaves route_tie bytes unchanged across all three modes; strip comments in the derive script.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: No P0 gaps. P1 behaviour changes: hue change FULL (byte pins + tier loop + mutation proof), dash-pattern FULL (predicate pin, mutation-proven), CVD de-conflict PARTIAL -> ~83%. Derive-script tool change (P3) has no direct test; overall ~80%.
recommended_fix: Add the state_congested vs route_tie pair to palcheck's CVD oracle and pin mode-table route_tie absence to raise P1 to >=90% and the gate to PASS.
